title: Do Improvements in the Information Environment Enhance Insiders’ Ability to Learn from Outsiders?
primary_theories: informational feedback effect of stock prices

rival_explanations: a general increasing time trend in investment-to-price sensitivity unrelated to the IFRS information shock

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (all WorldScope-covered firms, excluding regulated industries — financials and utilities, SIC 6000-6999 and 4900-4949)
context.country_region: 50 countries (treatment: 31 mandatory IFRS-adopting countries; control: 19 non-IFRS-adopting countries)
context.sample_size: 32,158 firms (284,748 firm-year observations) for the investment-to-price analysis; 9,844 M&A deals for the deal-completion analysis

data_sources.name: Daske et al. [2013] internet appendix (voluntary IFRS adopters)

analyses.label: Table 3, Panel A: Baseline results (investment sensitivity to stock price)
analyses.sample: full sample vs non-IFRS control (models 1-2); matched-by-industry-and-size control (model 3); voluntary IFRS adopters as control (model 4)

controls.name: Log assets (natural logarithm of lagged total assets, 2010 prices)
country, industry, and year fixed effects (firm and year fixed effects in model 2)

analyses.label: Table 3, Panel B: Robustness tests (restricted (-5,+5) window; asset growth proxy)
analyses.sample: 10 years around mandatory IFRS adoption (-5,+5), firms with at least two pre and post observations

key_ivs.name: Q_{t-1} x Post x IFRS
key_ivs.measure: triple interaction of lagged Tobin's q, Post-IFRS indicator, and IFRS treatment indicator

controls.name: country, industry, and year fixed effects

analyses.label: Table 4, Panel A: Event time analysis
analyses.sample: treatment sample of mandatory IFRS adopters (95,517 firm-year observations)

key_ivs.name: Q_{t-1} x Event
key_ivs.measure: lagged Q interacted with Event indicator (=1 for years t and t+1, zero otherwise)

controls.name: country, industry, and year fixed effects (firm and year fixed effects in model 2)

analyses.label: Table 4, Panel B: True and counterfactual events (placebo)
analyses.shock_or_instrument: mandatory IFRS adoption (with 2005 counterfactual event date for non-IFRS adopters)
analyses.sample: treatment vs non-IFRS adopters (model 1); treatment vs voluntary IFRS adopters (model 2)

key_ivs.name: Q_{t-1} x IFRS Counterfactual
key_ivs.measure: lagged Q interacted with counterfactual-event indicator (=1 after 2005 for non-IFRS adopters; year after mandatory country adoption for voluntary adopters)

controls.name: country, industry, and year fixed effects

analyses.label: Table 5: Changes in foreign institutional ownership and investment sensitivity to stock price
analyses.sample: treatment sample of mandatory IFRS adopters; institutional-ownership data available 2000-2010 (74,785 observations)

key_ivs.name: Q_{t-1} x Post x Delta Foreign IO

controls.name: Post indicator, Q_{t-1}, and lower-order Delta Foreign IO interactions
country, industry, and year fixed effects

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: 9,844 M&A deals announced 1990-2012 (deal value >= $10M, majority acquisitions); non-IFRS control (model 1), matched sample (model 2), treatment acquirers all deals (models 3-4) and cross-border only (models 5-6)

key_ivs.name: Post x SYNERGY x LEARN
key_ivs.measure: triple interaction of Post-IFRS indicator, SYNERGY, and LEARN; variable of interest predicted positive and significant

key_ivs.name: LEARN
key_ivs.measure: indicator for deals more likely to involve learning: (1) IFRS (=1 for acquirers from IFRS-adopting treatment countries), (2) Important (international deals with targets in countries where acquirer's primary two-digit-SIC industry is top 20% of market cap and acquirer had an increase in foreign IO from the target country), (3) Target IFRS (international deals where target country also adopts IFRS and acquirer had an increase in foreign IO from target country)

controls.name: Acquirer market value (41 days before announcement) / Deal value scaled by acquirer MV
year, acquirer country, and industry fixed effects

analyses.label: Table 7, Panel B: Learning and post-acquisition operating performance
analyses.sample: subsample of completed deals (acquiring firms); full/matched non-IFRS control (models 1-4) and treatment acquirers (models 5-8)

key_ivs.name: Post x LEARN
key_ivs.measure: interaction of Post-IFRS indicator with LEARN proxy (IFRS, Important, or Target IFRS); variable of interest predicted positive and significant

controls.name: Relative size (deal value as proportion of acquirer market value)
Cash (100% cash) and Stock (100% stock) financed indicators
year, industry, and acquirer country fixed effects

analyses.label: Table 8: Learning and post-acquisition stock performance
analyses.sample: monthly acquirer-vs-matched-control return observations; full/matched non-IFRS control (models 1-2) and treatment acquirers (models 3-4)

dv.name: Difference in monthly log returns (acquirer vs matched control)

key_ivs.name: Post x LEARN
key_ivs.measure: interaction of Post-IFRS indicator with LEARN proxy (IFRS, Important, or Target IFRS)

controls.name: Delta Beta (market model, weekly returns t-60 to t-12)
Delta Growth in PPE (annual change in PPE scaled by total assets)
country, industry, and year fixed effects
